posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-sodamem 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c16e4aad78032ea0eb9b.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-sodamem is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c16e4aad78032ea0eb9b.html
